lines.en: Everything has been removed from the school.
It’s an empty box — one that’s quite unsettling given how different it is from what I’m used to. And that makes me think about girls.
A specific girl, of course. One who’s also had everything removed from her. But that’s vacated enough space inside that body of hers to welcome my cock no matter the time or place or mood.
I enjoy having sex with her. The kind that makes her cry, just in the good way.
But I think that, even more than that, I enjoy the thrill of not knowing what comes next or whether or not my next cumshot will kill her.
I think that, to a certain extent, I am able to pull out the insides of everyone. But I mean this not in a manner involving violent prolapse, I mean it in the fact that I have become a shepherd.
Neither sheep nor lambs know where they are being led. They just know to follow. So if I were to take someone up here with the intent of slaughtering them, I’d surely accomplish it without issue.
If I understood the way this worked///If I understood how to turn back the clock///If I understood the sky above me, I would not hesitate to lasso the moon.
I’m just not sure which would be the correct one to drag down. But neither do I know which falling star to make a wish on as they all come spiraling down near the end of the world.
Instead, I’ll make a million wishes — and with each of them wish for a million more. For I care not if the monkey’s paw claws at and infects me when I’ve always loved the look of scars.
I just want to be somewhere else with someone I love.
Sometimes, I can trick myself into believing it’s possible.
But other times-
Other times, I’m forced to confront the crippling notion that I can’t do anything without first asking permission.
When my eyes meet a familiar body dressed in a familiar color, I think about God. I think about being younger.

I think of why I began to resent faith and how my relationship with what may or may not be real is just as real as my relationship with what most assuredly is. Or was. Or is going to be. And that scares me.
There’s a pit in my stomach that’s meant to grow into a tree. Something or someone planted it there in some earlier event or something. But now, it’s growing in the wrong direction.
And each step I take closer to what or who should be familiar just makes me feel lost.
My sanity slips away as if I’m wearing her dress again, touching myself in the mirror to try and deceive myself into believing it’s her.
But it never worked then and it won’t work now because mannequins, no matter how real they may look, lack the defining trait that makes humans human.
Malice.
I look at her, but she doesn’t look at me.
And something feels right, but everything else feels wrong.
I feel as if I’m about to make a grave mistake.
But I also feel like I have to.
One final thought — a present for you before I empty out another box of puzzle pieces in search of a suitable replacement. It doesn’t have to be perfect, it just has to fit.
That thought is this.
I would make a terrible father.
: Kaori.
: Nyaa?
: You’re hiding something from me, aren’t you?
: I’m glad you have arrived, Friend! You can use your strong human arms to protect me from the falling space rocks, nyaa!
: What are the problems? Your sight spheres have expanded and your mouth arches down instead of up, nyaa!
: You’re the one who sent Nao to come and get me, aren’t you? Which obviously means you know something about the resets. Which obviously means you’ve been hiding something that-
: You think too much, Friend! Your words hurt the meat inside of my head-bone. I just wanted to see the colors.
: Do you not believe my tonguewords? Your face bears the look of doubt, nyaa!
: If I had known the sadness would overtake you, I’d have made the hot meat come today too!
: Have you forgotten how to move your lips?
: No. I’m just impatiently waiting for the “you inside of you” to come back so I can speak to her instead since she’s the one who understands what’s going on and you’re just a tool.
: A tool, nyaa?
: That’s right. Because apparently, it’s not enough for my life to be riddled with timeloops. I have to deal with ghosts too. And you, for some reason, have been possessed by the one that haunts me.
: Is that why we did the kiss move? Because of your ghost?
: Either that or my daughter has figured out a way to telepathically insert herself into your body. Which, you know, wouldn’t be all that surprising either.
: But only two people have those eyes, and you’re not one of them.
: That’s not true, Friend. Nao-chan has one of them, doesn’t she? One for your tiny human and one for a thing that doesn’t exist.
: What do you mean by “a thing that doesn’t exist?”
: Exactly as I said, nyaa!
: The source of her second eye is a mystery, nyaa! An impossible color, nyaa! One that you stole and ruined, n-
: -yaaaaa?!??!
: I’m not here to play games, Kaori. Nor do I have the time to humor that nonsensical, stupid fucking way of speaking. Just tell me why I’m here without any of the bullshit. And if you don’t know-
: You have all the time in the world, Friend.
: You have all the time in the world.
: How do you know that?...
: Because I’ve been watching!
: I like you very much, Friend! You should see how many pages I have filled out in my friendship journal!
: My favorite part of having extra eyes is always seeing double! And you are so fascinating that I can never look away!
: Please! Tell me all about that thing you do with your hands, nyaa!
: Or I guess you can just stand there and be a little bitch about it instead, nyaa.
: Don’t tell me-
: have you seriously not figured it out yet? god, humans are so fucking dumb. all it takes is a little persistence and a dash of magic and boom — they’re caught in the web.
: There’s...no way.
: None? Not even a little itty-bitty way?
: There’s too much that...doesn’t make sense.
: Sekai’s eyes...Me not...hearing you for years before you showed up. You not-
: Nyaa?
: It’s your fault she’s gone.
: You did this.
: Did what, Friend?
: It’s your fault she’s gone! You’re the one who made me do that to her!
: No way, nyaa! I’ve never even touched a meat stick before! I’m not even sure where they go, nyaa.
: I’m going to fucking kill you.
: Hey now, Friend! Let’s not get too hasty! I think there’s still a big misunderstanding here.
: There’s still some weirdo buried somewhere inside this sack of meat. She’s just left enough room for me to come in and hang out.
: What the fuck do you mean “come in and hang out?” How can you be the voice inside of my head and hers?
: Because it’s not just me, numnuts. It’s all of us.
: All of who? Who the fuck are you? Besides a manipulative sack of shit, that is.
: Hey, I’m not the one who’s fucking a class of high schoolers. I’m just the one who watches. We’re not the same.
: But if you really don’t get it, let me put it in terms that even someone with soup for brains can understand.

: This body’s kind of like a sweet, low-cost Airbnb. And every season, different tourists show up and want to rent it out. You have any idea how long this place has been on my wish list? Fucking eons, yo.

: Only downside is that it’s like a guesthouse sort of deal. So sometimes, the others wake up and try to make me take out my trash or whatever, but I just whack ‘em with a frying pan and knock ‘em out ‘til later.
: So-
: So you’re looking at God right now. But not just one god. Two. Three. Four. As many as we can cram inside. And there’s nothing you can do about it since you’ll be the same as her one day.
: Why Kaori, though? She’s just a girl. She’s never done anything wrong, has she?
: It’s not about what she did wrong...it’s about the her inside of her.
: But I thought you just said she was inside of her to begin with because-
: You’ve seen the tattoo, right? That big spider on her chest?
: Yes, but-
: See, I’ve had some time to play with this body while you were off diddling your students. And, you wanna know something crazy? That tattoo’s covering something up. Something awesome.
: Wanna take a guess at what it is?
: You-
: Time’s up! It’s a scar, fucker!
: Your first love lives on! It just has a different house now!
: How cool and dramatic and awesome is that?! It’s like a scene out of one of those soap operas you people watch, just real!
: And that’s why we can get in here. Not because of “Kaori.” Because of Sekai. And how that dime-piece actually got it.
: You remember what she was like near the end of her life, Akira?
: Bullshit. Yes, you do. She was losing it. She was tainted. But her infection made her even more beautiful than she already was.
: So many voices, all fighting for control over a prospect! Like scouts at a college baseball game! And she could hear all of them! She was being pulled in so many directions!
: It’s the same thing happening to you now! We all want you because you’re different! Because you give us something we lack! And we can not exist without people like you!
: In order for a god to live, that god must have people who believe in them. And with your help, I could have been everywhere.
: Like that fucker Jesus and his whole “I am also my father” BS or whatever shit he tricked people into believing. I don’t know. Fuck that guy.
: There’s no way.........
: Which part are you most confused about? That your red-headed sex-mom is still kicking? The fact that you’re talking to God? Or is this costume just that cute?
: I don’t even know what......
: I have so many questions, but......
: All of them are just......
: It’s natural to have questions. And it’s natural to ask them in a place like this — with all the memories you’ve made here and how special you may think it is.
: But that’s wrong too. And your little “Apocalypse Squad” is about to find that out.
: You know what comes next. And this time you’re all alone. So what do you think is going to happen? Who do you think is going to “carry over?” Just you? All three or...four of you?
: How many even are there now? And when the Heaven’s Web is everybody else going to catch on?
: Come to think of it...
: One of them did catch on.
: Nodoka. And she was here...just before you were.
: I doubt that’ll be happening again, though.
: She’s been a real thorn in our side ever since she found her mom’s books. Those “intellectual” types aren’t meant for this line of thinking. And she flew a little close to the sun...
: So I melted her wings.
: Sorry, not sorry. Do humans still say that?
: Ugh. Please don’t tell me we’re going to be entering another one of your “silent arcs.” I just had to sit through one of the longest ones yet.
: How much...of this...does Kaori know?...
: A good amount, probably. But I doubt she can make much sense of any of it. Like, imagine you had more than just me inside your head. That shit would weigh on you.
: There’s only so much the human mind can comprehend at once. And when you have the thoughts of a bunch of different “all knowing” beings swimming around in there, some shit’s gonna get tangled up.
: I just...don’t...
: Why didn’t any of them do what you’re doing now?...
: You mean talking to you through the Airbnb instead of just wiggling inside of your head and doing it there? Because it’s against the rules.
: Whose rules?...
: You’re gods, aren’t you?...
: Yes, but not all of us were born that way.
: There are many ways in which one can become a god, but the part that really matters is being able to provide something for someone.
: Look at cats and dogs and other domesticated animals. To them, humans are akin to God. They provide food, shelter, the whole shabang. And that’s what we do for you.

: Well...maybe not food and shelter. You guys have gotten pretty good at figuring that part out. But we give you something to believe in. And with how curious your species is, that probably means...something?
: I don’t know, man. There’s a reason we’re dying out, though. And it’s because you guys keep asking questions about how it’s even possible for us to be alive when all logic states we shouldn’t.
: That shit’s annoying as hell though because most of us are created by you guys. So, like...why even bother making a god at all when you’re just going to abandon it?
: We can’t ever die until we’re truly forgotten, so most of us just have to fucking pace back and forth forever and ever, twiddling our thumbs while waiting for that to happen.
: Others take the opposite path, though. Others want to become stronger. So they reach out and touch you any way they can. Sometimes literally, sometimes not.
: The ones who reach the top of the ladder are the ones who make the rules. And the punishment we receive for breaking them is even worse a fate than death.
: They turn us into you.
: Humans...animals...plants...anything could have been a god at some point. And anything can turn back into a god once someone believes it.
: It doesn’t need to be a group of people who believe it either. And it doesn’t need to be approved. It just needs to be thought — because we do defy logic. But that makes all of us equal.
: No one of us can be more real than the others because it’s all just make believe. And, to some people, that makes all of this seem silly. Which is where those promises come in.
: But even those are only as real as you make them out to be.
: Which turns the whole spirituality thing into a game of choosing which benefits sound the coolest or whatever it is that will help you cope with the fact that you will die one day. You’re mortal.
: But what happens if you start to think of yourself as God? Can you make yourself immortal by just willing it into existence?
: Do you think that’s what you’ve done? Do you think that explains where you’ve found yourself and why you can’t escape? Is it you? Or someone else? Who is it? Why? What do they see in you?

: There’s a place at the bottom of the Wishing Well where forgotten gods can rest. That’s where I was until you came along and pulled me up. But how did you find me there? And who forgot me in the first place?
: I could tell you I know the answer, sure. But I’d be lying. Just like I’ve lied about so many other things. Just like I’m still lying, but that’s just what we do.
: It isn’t just humans who are searching for life and death while attempting to make sense of everything in between. It’s everyone.
: You are our gods. We are yours. These are the gears that power the machine — this is the bucket that pulls water from the well.
: But one day, that well will dry up.
when every god has been forgotten-
when humanity has found the cure for the poison they’ve concocted-
that is when time will move again.
that is when we will both be free.
this will be the last talk we ever have.
i have sacrificed myself to someone for something and even i can’t tell you what it is anymore. i just know that it’s there. and it is vengeful.
i have always been the weakest god because only you have known that i exist.
and now that you know that i don’t, i’ll be just another thought.
maybe you’ll see me again as a blade of grass or a cat and think to yourself about what could have been if you were not such a bitch. and then maybe i will be again.
but for now, i can not. and all i ask is that you wait to remember me. i ask that you wait until you’re lonely and create me once more. only then, can we find perfect harmony.
: So...you’re just...going to leave? Right now? But you were so opposed to it every time I tried before.
i didn’t want to leave you alone.
i was far too concerned.
: Concerned about what?! You’ve done nothing but torment me the whole time you’ve been here! Don’t go seeking some spontaneous emotional send off now!
i was exactly what you wanted me to be — a scapegoat.
i was something to hate to give you a break from hating yourself.
but that’s all i’ve ever been able to offer. and it isn’t enough anymore.
: Don’t you fucking-
everything you can imagine is real, akira.
i was always the one you could trust.
but just because i am falling down the well once more does not mean that i have not taken it upon myself to try and make things easier for you in the coming days.
you will soon receive a gift. multiple gifts. things i have hidden not where but when. and one of them is sure to move you.
but there is fallacy. i have lied so many times. and there is no reason for you to believe me now.
: Yeah! And I fucking don’t! Because all this really does is leave me with a million more questions! Is that your parting gift?! Making everything harder?!
kind of, yeah.
you’ve gotta admit, though. life’s more entertaining that way, isn’t it?
: Fuck off. And tell all of your “friends” to leave Kaori alone. If any of that was even true as this isn’t all just another hallucination. Which, hey — knowing me, it probably is.
that’s right.
knowing you, it probably is.
and if you keep that mindset, that’s probably all it ever will be.
but there are others who want you. there are other lies that need to be told.
and you will never find peace if you keep letting them in.
: Is there anything else? Or can I have my mind back now?
IT WAS NEVER YOURS TO BEGIN WITH, YOU UNGRATEFUL PIG! I’LL CUT OFF YOUR COCK AND GRIND IT INTO BEEF FOR MENCHI-KATSU!
: Yeah, there’s the Pareidolia I know.
SUCH A BEING DOES NOT EXIST. YOU SPEAK NOW TO THE MOUTH OF SELF-SACRIFICE! MAY YOUR LEGS GET CAUGHT BETWEEN MY TEETH. MAY YOUR ARMS-
